exposure: Aerobic exercise combined with systematic nursing care
S/D ratio in umbilical blood flow
cohort: 200 patients with gestational hypertension treated from May 2023 to May 2024.
finding: Combining aerobic exercise with systematic nursing care significantly improved psychological health, blood pressure control, pregnancy outcomes, neonatal birth weights, Apgar scores, and patient satisfaction in patients with gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: The observation group receiving aerobic exercise and systematic nursing care showed a significantly higher rate of vaginal delivery compared to the control group.
